en: You know, Marie is scared of the night.
Why is that?
'Cause it feels like all of a sudden
I'm all alone
It's all right. You're not alone anymore.
You can be with everyone at night, too.
Really
Do you study at school too, mister?
A mister I don't know.
People I don't know,
I'm not supposed to talk to them, they said.
What's wrong?
Aren't you feeling well?
, why do you
, you
Do you believe that?
, too.
Please give me your orders......
...Currently Closed...
Business Hours 10:30 - 15:00
(A wasted trip...)
(Another wasted trip...)
Oh,
I'm so sorry, after you came all this way,
but we're closed.
Sorry, but I've closed up the shop.
I'm Helene, the owner.
How about this shirt and tie?
(What poor taste.
It can't hold a candle to Orgo's tie.)
If there's anything you like,
you're welcome to try it on.
Clothes are something the lady of the house
usually sews herself, right? Spinning thread, weaving...
But now cloth can be woven in factories.
Then it's dyed at a dye works, and a tailor
sews it up...
As long as you have money, you don't need
to make anything yourself. That's the world now.
The fabric, you know, is imported
on trading ships. It's cheaper that way.
Hard to believe, isn't it?
Do you know what a sewing machine is?

variants.en: do you know what a sewing machine is?

en: I hear it's a contraption where a machine
does even the needlework for you.
They say even ordinary households
in the big cities use them.
It sounds just like magic, doesn't it?
From now on, you'll need money for everything.
We're heading into a new age, aren't we?
(A world where coin can buy blood
is unlikely ever to come.)
A new age, is it...
The future means nothing to me.
Mm... mmm.
...You!
Awake now, Helene?
That negligee looks like your own handiwork.
What are you doing here?!
Why are YOU here?!
Why?!
Well, well.
For a lady so attuned to the changing times,
you're awfully flustered by this little change.
At this rate, the new age and your sewing machine
will both run off and leave you behind.
Get out!
I'll call for help!
Just as I thought. For all your talk of machines and money,
in the end, it's "people" you rely on, isn't it?
Well, no matter.
In fact, I too need living flesh, not machines.
Sorry, Helene, but your trip into the new age
is one I've decided you won't be taking.
Now, come with me
and let us walk the "Devil's Path" together.
Eeeek!
(Maybe I should come back at another time...)
